{"metadata":{"description":"Self-control guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness host exit and restart workflows.","id":"gh:1333246244","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-self-control-guard","slug":"pandashere/dsh-self-control-guard","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Self-control guard plugin for DeepSeek Harness host exit and restart workflows."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# self-control-guard"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A self-control guard for the DeepSeek Harness host process."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"When developing DSH plugins, an agent frequently — by accident or by a misfired command — **kills it"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"s own host process** (`pkill dsh`, `kill -9 <host-pid>`, `kill $PPID`, `killall dsh`). The session d"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ies mid-task, work is lost, and there is no audit trail. This plugin is designed to **prevent agent "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"self-termination**: it intercepts high-confidence host-kill attempts from the `bash` tool, hard-deni"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"es them, teaches the model the controlled exit tool, and leaves an audit trail."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"It does three things:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"1. **Intercepts** high-confidence attempts to terminate the host from the `bash` tool (canonical `ki"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ll <host-pid>`, `kill $PPID`, `pkill dsh`, `killall dsh` forms) with a monotonic hard denial that no"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" `pre-execute` listener can force-allow.
2. **Teaches** the model the controlled tools — `dsh_self_e"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"xit` always, and `dsh_self_restart` only when `restartEnabled: true` (hidden by default — TBD, see K"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"nown Limitations) — by injecting a pinned guidance message right after an interception. The tools ar"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"e **registered up front but hidden**: they never appear in the model-facing tool list (`hidden: true"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"` keeps them out of `schemas()`), so an unassisted model cannot discover them by enumeration — yet t"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"hey stay callable by name, so a caller that learns them from outside the tool list (the guard's deni"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"al text, a user instruction, another tool) can invoke them immediately.
3. **Runs a token-confirmed "},{"id":"p8s10","text":"graceful exit/restart** through the launcher's existing seams: the headless runner's `ctx.headlessIo"},{"id":"p8s11","text":".exit(code)` (code-exact) on one-shot runs, and the launcher's `SIGTERM` graceful shutdown on long-l"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"ived surfaces (web)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Requirements: Node.js 22 or newer and `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`.
The plugin ships as a standalon"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"e bundle installable into any DSH profile."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Build, validate, and pack it from the plugin directory:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Install the generated tarball into a DSH profile, then restart `dsh web`.
Installing the source dire"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ctory as a link is not supported because host peers
are supplied by the DSH profile:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The plugin has no browser bundle. Verify it in the Web settings plugin list.
To update, build a tarb"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"all with a newer package version, remove the installed
bundle, add the new tarball, and restart. To "},{"id":"p16s3","text":" newer package version, remove the installed
bundle, add the new tarball, and restart. To uninstall:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Fail-loud at load: duplicate or empty `interceptModes`, `exitCode === restartExitCode`, `confirmatio"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"nCalls < 2`, non-positive TTL, negative cooldown, an invalid enum member, or a duplicate `privileged"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"Bash.matchers` list throws — never a silent fall-back. `enabled: false` is the only way to fully dis"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"t throws — never a silent fall-back. `enabled: false` is the only way to fully disable interception."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Interception coverage"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Intercepted (hard-denied)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The matcher (`src/matcher.ts`) is a pure function over the `bash` tool's `command` argument: it scan"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"s the command list under a bounded shell subset (resource caps: 64 KiB input, 4096 tokens, nesting d"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"epth 32) and applies the canonical allowlist to every extracted simple command:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| matcher id | canonical forms |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Not intercepted (abstain — passes through)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Unsupported constructs **abstain** rather than guess, so they run for real:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **Dynamic construction**: `$VAR`, `"$HOST"`, `${HOST}`, `$(...)`, backticks, globs, heredocs — the"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" matcher sees the **unexpanded** shell source at `pre-execute` time, so a variable target is indisti"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"nguishable from any other dynamic value.
- **Shell functions**: a function body (`run() { kill ...; "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"}`) or a function call that wraps a kill — the matcher does not enter function bodies.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"#### What the model sees"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"After a canonical host-kill command is blocked, that agent receives the guidance below. The controll"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ed tools are registered up front but hidden, so they never appear in the tool list on their own — th"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"is guidance is how the model first learns their names and payloads."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- **Not a security boundary.** Obfuscation, base64, command substitution, shell functions, `setsid`,"},{"id":"p33s2","text":" interpreters, `kill -1`, `pidfd_send_signal`, process-group signals, PTY (node-pty spawns outside `"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"ctx.subprocess`), MCP, Code Runtime, and `cordis_mount` (same-process, bash-equivalent trust) all by"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"pass the matcher. Preventing host termination is OS isolation work (PID namespaces, seccomp, supervi"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"sor), out of scope here.
- **Web restart has no distinct exit code.** The web surface exits via `SIG"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"TERM` with the launcher's code; a supervisor cannot distinguish "restart requested" from a plain exi"},{"id":"p33s7","text":"t by code. A code-exact channel needs launcher cooperation and is deferred. The exit is dispatched o"},{"id":"p33s8","text":"nly after the accepted tool's turn settles (`agent.whenIdle()`), with a 10s bounded fallback timer.
"},{"id":"p33s9","text":"- **Restart tool is hidden by default (TBD).** `dsh_self_restart` is not registered unless `restartE"},{"id":"p33s10","text":"nabled: true` — the web surface has no supervisor, so a confirmed restart only terminates the host w"},{"id":"p33s11","text":"ithout auto-reviving it. The code path is retained; revive the flow once a supervisor channel exists"},{"id":"p33s12","text":".
- **Hidden registration is process-global and not revoked.** The tools register on the plugin's gl"},{"id":"p33s13","text":"obal context at load: every agent/session can call them by name (execution stays gated by `allowedAg"},{"id":"p33s14","text":"ents`), but they stay out of the model tool list for the whole life of the plugin; HMR or plugin unl"},{"id":"p33s15","text":"oad removes them with the effect. There is no disclosure event: the guard denies, teaches, and the m"},{"id":"p33s16","text":"odel calls the already-registered tools.
- **Denied-command false positives.** A user legitimately t"},{"id":"p33s17","text":"erminating another dsh instance, or a wrapper changing the meaning of `$PPID`, is reported. The matc"},{"id":"p33s18","text":"her is deliberately conservative to keep this bounded: it never uses substring matching, and dynamic"},{"id":"p33s19","text":" construction (`$VAR`, `$(...)`, backticks, globs, heredocs), assignment prefixes (`X=1 kill ...`), "},{"id":"p33s20","text":"and unsupported shell syntax all abstain. The legitimate case now has a documented exit: `dsh_self_b"},{"id":"p33s21","text":"ash` re-executes the blocked command under a token + approval gate (full-access exempt); `kill-host-"},{"id":"p33s22","text":"pid` is excluded by design.
